title: Hearing on NYC's Vision Zero street safety strategy
summary: The Council's Transportation Committee will examine the city's Vision Zero initiative, including recent trends in traffic fatalities, enforcement levels and new mayoral street safety plans. The hearing will also consider several bills on topics such as protected bike lanes, low-traffic neighborhood pilots, intelligent speed assistance devices and a dangerous driving study, plus a resolution on a state drag racing bill. As of September 30, 2026, the city had recorded 151 traffic deaths for the year, with e-bike and scooter fatalities rising even as overall deaths fall.
